reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26103182 on 2026-10-02, gateway LP storage resolves to 0x3fea1cb36d2c5523c062d0e060eac253608b4daf. Its getTotalReservesInfo() identifies the three exact reserve tokens; every tracked quantity equals its treasury token balance. Current issuer API product addresses and values match the pinned tuple: TKUSD 304595.134265585947553817, CUMFU 303739.818920391652339903 and FUIDL-AC 616041.200182124511630189, totaling 1224376.153368102111523909 in issuer-marked USD. The API's published six-decimal ratios directly supply the authored percentages (24.8776%, 24.8077%, 50.3147%). latestBundleTimestamp() is 2026-10-02T07:05:01Z, independently dating the issuer NAV mark publication; updateAt 1776736295 remains reserve configuration time in April. This refresh records a new current token-inventory and publisher-NAV observation, not a financial report or independently authenticated underlying fund holdings. W2R49 liquidity-only research recovered the actual August 2026 Kaitai memorandum (not the unrelated Taikang ETF) and September 14 2026 ChinaAMC Digital OFC prospectus through the managers' rendered document archives. Appendix D governs TKUSD tokenized Class T; Schedule 5 governs CUMFU tokenized unlisted Class F. Both permit extreme-market redemption payment delays up to one calendar month from properly documented token-redemption requests, so both are conservatively categorized over-seven-days, not by daily dealing frequency or normal one-/three-business-day marketing. This is a governing token-claim delay category, not a measured whole-position stress realization guarantee; suspension, partial acceptance, distributor transfer and compliance conditions remain. No finite maturityDaysMax is inferred from underlying portfolio WAM or instrument mandates. FUIDL-AC liquidity remains unknown. Composition percentages and October 2 observation date are unchanged; independent underlying financial reconciliation, priority and recovery look-through remain unknown across 100% of the book.
